notes.title: Slum Ball Full Version finally available
notes.notes:
Dear VR fans!

The full version of Slum Ball is out!  We put our hearts and souls into this game to make it as fun as possible. U24 team hopes that you like what we have come up with.

Enjoy! :)

notes.title: Full version coming soon!
notes.notes:
We will be releasing the full version of Slum Ball 

Features include:

- world's 1st photorealistic level in a game
- awesome tournaments
- more fun and physical activity

Our tournament is on hold for now but we will be back soon with a better game!

We appreciate all the positive feedback and we are working towards bringing you a better experience.
